en: I'm Germán Massello, and I built Plumb.
es: I'm Germán Maselo, and I built Plumb.

en: A red pipeline is your code, or your test.
es: A red pipeline is either your code, or your test.

en: Plumb tells them apart, and acts on each.
es: Plumb tells them apart, and acts on each one.

en: For the developer on CI duty, every red pipeline is a guess.
es: For the developer on C I duty, every red pipeline is a guess.

en: Teams re-run flaky tests, mute them, or delete them.
es: Teams re-run flaky tests, mute them, or delete them.

en: Plumb runs on GitLab Duo Agent Platform.
es: Plumb runs on GitLab Duo Agent Platform.

en: CI measures the verdict. A Duo flow acts on it.
es: C I measures the verdict, and a Duo flow acts on it.

en: This page explains it in plain English and Spanish.
es: This page explains it in plain English, and in Spanish.

en: I push a commit that breaks one test by order.
es: I push a commit that breaks one test by order.

en: The e2e job fails, and main turns red.
es: The end to end job fails, and main turns red.

en: First it rules out disk, memory and network failures.
es: First it rules out disk, memory and network failures.

en: flake-verdict re-runs that test 10 times.
es: Flake verdict re-runs that test ten times.

en: It passes once, then fails: state leaks between runs.
es: It passes once, then fails every time, because state leaks between runs.

en: The red pipeline starts the Duo triage flow.
es: The red pipeline starts the Duo triage flow.

en: It reads the verdict and names the cause: shared state.
es: It reads the verdict and names the cause: shared state.

en: It edits only the test, and opens a merge request.
es: It edits only the test file, and opens a merge request.

en: The description quotes the evidence and the history.
es: The description quotes the evidence, and the test's history.

en: The fix puts back the reset the test was missing.
es: The fix puts back the reset the test was missing.

en: It never touches application code or CI.
es: It never touches application code, or C I.

en: fix-proof runs the changed test 50 times.
es: Fix proof runs the changed test fifty times.

en: A skipped or deleted test fails the proof.
es: A skipped or deleted test fails the proof.

en: 50 of 50 pass, so merge-gate merges it.
es: Fifty out of fifty pass, so merge gate merges it.

en: No human touched it. Main is green again.
es: No human touched it, and main is green again.

en: Then main deploys to Google Cloud Run.
es: Then main deploys to Google Cloud Run.

en: Plumb also knows when not to act.
es: Plumb also knows when not to act.

en: A real regression gets an issue, and no code change.
es: A real regression gets an issue, and no code change.

en: An intended redesign waits for a human to approve.
es: An intended redesign gets a test update, that waits for a human to approve it.

en: A test already fixed twice is quarantined, not fixed again.
es: A test already fixed twice is quarantined, not fixed again.

en: One fix passed only 33 of 50, so it was not merged.
es: One fix passed only thirty-three out of fifty, so it was not merged.

en: The flow swapped it for a quarantine and an issue.
es: The flow swapped it for a quarantine and an issue.

en: It picked the right cause in 12 of 12 runs.
es: It picked the right cause in twelve out of twelve runs.

en: Every pipeline and flow session is public in the repo.
es: Every pipeline and flow session is public, in the repo.

en: Plumb is open source on GitLab. Thanks for watching.
es: Plumb is open source on GitLab, thanks for watching.
